desc: 冰薄荷绿视觉，含浴室场景、空白参数对照表与四宫格规格分栏
name: 冰薄荷清新牙膏口腔护理款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼赢得点击，主体轮廓干净且平台合规
用一条主张说清首要购买理由，落实主图一秒法则
shots.textZone: frosted rounded panel at the top right

shots.intent: 用齿间与膏体微距交代使用动作与质地，替代不可验证的功效表述
让买家把自己代入晨间护理日常，建立每天使用联想
shots.textZone: lower left third of the frame

shots.intent: 以磨砂卡叠空样片的结构承接配方逻辑，具体信息一律留空待填
shots.textZone: frosted card upper left, three stacked label rows

shots.intent: 用俯视叶床与空图标清单承接信任诉求，规避任何资质杜撰
shots.textZone: frosted card left half, five icon rows

shots.intent: 用双款并排与全空白对照表帮买家选款，消除选错疑虑
shots.textZone: upper left headline zone plus five row labels and two column headers

shots.intent: 四宫格交代多种规格与组合，让买家按用量自行对号入座
shots.textZone: one frosted label bar along the bottom edge of each quadrant

shots.intent: 以整排陈列收口，引导连带选购与回店浏览整条产品线
shots.textZone: top third frosted band plus five hexagon tags

style.backgroundSystem: seamless clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, iced mint green #BFE3CE panels for benefit and scene screens, matte stone surfaces #EDF2EF for infographics, dense fresh mint leaf bed #2F5B3F for overhead nature screens; one frosted translucent rounded card carries every information layer
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in charcoal #33383D, rounded hexagon tags and frosted rounded cards, no chemical structure diagrams, no filled tick or cross marks, no certification seals
style.lightingSystem: cool bright high-key studio light, front-left key with soft fill, soft contact shadows only, sweeping rim highlight along the tube shoulder, dappled leaf shadows in scene and overhead screens, 5500K in bathroom scenes
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean fresh mint oral-care visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, matte stone #EDF2EF, iced mint green #BFE3CE and deep leaf green #2F5B3F with charcoal text #33383D; cool bright high-key studio lighting with a front-left key, soft fill, soft contact shadows and a sweeping rim highlight; modern geometric sans-serif with one italic serif accent for a single emphasis word; thin single-weight line icons and rounded hexagon tags; frosted translucent rounded cards as the only information layer; tube presented standing on its flip-top cap with the label facing camera and stable scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no filled-in spec numbers or badge wording.
noDrift: no filled-in numbers, dates, units or badge wording
no invented ingredient, efficacy or clinical claims
style.presentationRules: tube stands on its flip-top cap with the label facing camera, stable scale and slight 3/4 to straight-on hero angle across the set, paste ribbon prop used only as a background sweep, every spec cell and badge left as an empty placeholder
style.surfaceSystem: matte stone bathroom counter #EDF2EF, pale sage ceramic tile #BFE3CE, frosted glass shelf and rounded card, fresh mint foliage #2F5B3F
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for every label, one italic serif accent allowed only for a single emphasis word in a headline; headline and label copy always supplied as placeholders
